title: Deciphering the conformational stability of MazE7 antitoxin in Mycobacterium tuberculosis from molecular dynamics simulation study.
authors: Saha, Rituparna; Bhattacharje, Gourab; De, Soumya; Das, Amit Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究结核分枝杆菌MazEF7毒素-抗毒素系统与DNA复合物的构象动态，阐明抗毒素MazE7与DNA结合机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法为MD模拟，虽非典型TF-DNA体系但机制可迁移借鉴。
abstract: MazEF Toxin-antitoxin (TA) systems are associated with the persistent phenotype of the pathogen, Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb), aiding their survival. Though extensively studied, the mode of action between the antitoxin-toxin and DNA of this family remains largely unclear. Here, the important interactions between MazF7 toxin and MazE7 antitoxin, and how MazE7 binds its promoter/operator region have been studied. To elucidate this, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation has been performed on MazE7, MazF7, MazEF7, MazEF7-DNA, and MazE7-DNA complexes to investigate how MazF7 and DNA affect the conformational change and dynamics of MazE7 antitoxin. This study demonstrated that the MazE7 dimer is disordered and one monomer (Chain C) attains stability after binding to the MazF7 toxin. Both the monomers (Chain C and Chain D) however are stabilized when MazE7 binds to DNA. MazE7 is also observed to sterically inhibit tRNA from binding to MazF7, thus suppressing its toxic activity. Comparative structural analysis performed on all the available antitoxins/antitoxin-toxin-DNA structures revealed MazEF7-DNA mechanism was similar to another TA system, AtaRT_E.coli. Simulation performed on the crystal structures of AtaR, AtaT, AtaRT, AtaRT-DNA, and AtaR-DNA showed that the disordered AtaR antitoxin attains stability by AtaT and DNA binding similar to MazE7. Based on these analyses it can thus be hypothesized that the disordered antitoxins enable tighter toxin and DNA binding thus preventing accidental toxin activation. Overall, this study provides crucial structural and dynamic insights into the MazEF7 toxin-antitoxin system and should provide a basis for targeting this TA system in combating Mycobacterium tuberculosis.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: MazEF毒素-抗毒素（TA）系统与病原体结核分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Mtb）的持续表型相关，有助于其存活。尽管已被广泛研究，但该家族中抗毒素-毒素与DNA之间的作用模式仍 largely 不清楚。在此，研究了MazF7毒素与MazE7抗毒素之间的重要相互作用，以及MazE7如何结合其启动子/操纵子区域。为阐明这一点，对MazE7、MazF7、MazEF7、MazEF7-DNA和MazE7-DNA复合物进行了分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，以探究MazF7和DNA如何影响MazE7抗毒素的构象变化和动力学。本研究表明，MazE7二聚体呈无序状态，且一个单体（链C）在与MazF7毒素结合后获得稳定性。然而，当MazE7与DNA结合时，两个单体（链C和链D）均被稳定化。还观察到MazE7通过空间位阻抑制tRNA与MazF7结合，从而抑制其毒性活性。对所有可用的抗毒素/抗毒素-毒素-DNA结构进行的比较结构分析显示，MazEF7-DNA机制与另一个TA系统AtaRT_E.coli相似。对AtaR、AtaT、AtaRT、AtaRT-DNA和AtaR-DNA晶体结构进行的模拟表明，无序的AtaR抗毒素通过与AtaT和DNA结合获得稳定性，这与MazE7类似。基于这些分析，可以推测无序的抗毒素能够实现更紧密的毒素和DNA结合，从而防止意外毒素激活。总体而言，本研究为MazEF7毒素-抗毒素系统提供了关键的结构和动力学见解，并应为靶向该TA系统以对抗结核分枝杆菌提供基础。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
